classes.name: Paladin of the Dawn
classes.tagline: Oathbound vanguard who breaks curses with solar steel.
classes.perkDescription: +4 Max Vitality, +1 Base Armor, and Heroic choices bolster resolve.

skill.name: Sunfire Smite
skill.description: Deal radiant weapon damage (+5 bonus) and cleanse 1 Veil Dread on a killing blow or critical hit.

classes.name: Arcane Scholar
classes.tagline: Seeker of elder runes who unravels curses before blades are drawn.
classes.perkDescription: Advantage on Arcana checks, +3 Max Focus, and automatically crosses out 1 false answer on Relic Riddles.

skill.name: Astral Lance
skill.description: Fire a lance of pure starlight (+4 bonus damage) that ignores enemy Armor and Ward.

classes.name: Shadowblade
classes.tagline: Relic-breaker and scout who bends luck when steel falls short.
classes.perkDescription: Advantage on Agility checks, once per chapter stage reroll a failed skill check, and starts with a Smoke Veil.

skill.name: Shadowstep Strike
skill.description: Strike a foe's blind spot (+4 damage, +3 more if foe is telegraphing a heavy blow) and gain +4 Evasion until next turn.

classes.name: Fey Warden
classes.tagline: Keeper of emerald shrines who walks unbowed through the Veil.
classes.perkDescription: Negates the first Veil Dread gain in every chapter and heals 2 Vitality after victorious battles.

skill.name: Briar Grasp
skill.description: Ensnare the enemy in silver thorns (+3 damage) and Stun them, canceling their telegraphed attack!

gear_sunsteel_blade.name: Sunsteel Longsword
gear_sunsteel_blade.description: Tempered in Oakhaven's dawn-brazier. Reliable and keen.

gear_starwood_staff.name: Starwood Focus Staff
gear_starwood_staff.description: Carved from lightning-struck birch; channels arcane bolts smoothly.

gear_whisper_daggers.name: Twin Whisper Daggers
gear_whisper_daggers.description: Balanced obsidian-edged blades that strike twice in a heartbeat.

gear_thornwood_spear.name: Thornwood Glaive
gear_thornwood_spear.description: Living silver-ash polearm favored by frontier wardens.

gear_runebound_greatsword.name: Runebound Claymore
gear_runebound_greatsword.description: Etched with First Concord wards that flare golden against Veilspawn.

gear_celestial_scepter.name: Astrolabe Scepter
gear_celestial_scepter.description: Miniaturized brass rings orbit its tip, humming with sunken starlight.

gear_nightglass_fang.name: Nightglass Saber
gear_nightglass_fang.description: Weightless volcanic glass honed to slice through shadow and chainmail.

gear_sovereign_halberd.name: Ashenspire Sun-Halberd
gear_sovereign_halberd.description: Forged over living ley-flame. One swing scatters shadows like sparks.

gear_bastion_brigandine.name: Bastion Brigandine
gear_bastion_brigandine.description: Riveted steel scales over oiled leather.

gear_archive_mantle.name: Gilded Archive Mantle
gear_archive_mantle.description: Woven with copper sigil-thread that dampens stray curses.

gear_wayfarer_leathers.name: Wayfarer Shadow-Leathers
gear_wayfarer_leathers.description: Silent buckskin dyed with charcoal and silver-moss.

gear_barkweave_coat.name: Silver-Bark Coat
gear_barkweave_coat.description: Supple woven silverwood bark gifted by the Canopy elders.

gear_valen_plate.name: Aegis of Valenmoor
gear_valen_plate.description: Burnished heraldic cuirass bearing the winged spire crest.

gear_starlight_vestments.name: Vestments of the Loom
gear_starlight_vestments.description: Spun from prism-silk that bends blades and Veil energy alike.

gear_silverleaf_charm.name: Silverleaf Heart-Charm
gear_silverleaf_charm.description: A living silver birch leaf encased in amber; radiates steady warmth.

gear_vesper_compass.name: Vesper Star-Compass
gear_vesper_compass.description: Points not to north, but toward hidden truths and unguarded locks.

gear_ember_signet.name: Cinder-Lord's Signet
gear_ember_signet.description: Warm obsidian ring tempered in the heart of Ashenspire Forge.

gear_lantern_brooch.name: Wayfarer's Ward Brooch
gear_lantern_brooch.description: An antique brass brooch sold by Elric; glows softly near danger.

consumable_starleaf_draught.name: Starleaf Draught
consumable_starleaf_draught.description: Restores 12 Vitality immediately—usable in camp or mid-combat.

consumable_aether_phial.name: Aether Phial
consumable_aether_phial.description: Restores 4 Focus to fuel Class Skills and spells.

consumable_smoke_veil.name: Alchemist's Smoke Veil
consumable_smoke_veil.description: Grants +8 Ward Shield for the turn and restores 1 Focus.

consumable_sun_incense.name: Dawnfire Incense
consumable_sun_incense.description: Restores 6 Vitality and purges 1 Veil Dread.

relic_wayfarer_seal.name: Guild Wayfarer's Seal
relic_wayfarer_seal.description: Proves your authority from Oakhaven Bastion and opens warded gates.

relic_moonstone_lens.name: Moonstone Prism Lens
relic_moonstone_lens.description: Reveals invisible fey glyphs and falsified runes in silver light.

relic_silver_bell.name: Heartwood Chime
relic_silver_bell.description: Its pure tone calms corrupted spirits and shatters thorn wards.

relic_celestial_key.name: Brass Meridian Key
relic_celestial_key.description: Locks or reverses the spinning brass gears of the Sunken Astrolabe.

relic_tide_mirror.name: Mirror-Shard of Vesper
relic_tide_mirror.description: Reflects starlight illusions and exposes hidden astral currents.

relic_quench_rune.name: Frost-Quench Brand
relic_quench_rune.description: Cools runaway ley-valves and weakens molten drake scales.

relic_forge_charter.name: True Smiths' Charter
relic_forge_charter.description: Bears the original Concord oaths—turns wavering forge-guards into allies.

relic_concord_prism.name: First Concord Prism
relic_concord_prism.description: A facet of pure alabaster starlight capable of anchoring the Sovereign Loom.

relic_oath_lantern.name: Unfading Oath-Lantern
relic_oath_lantern.description: Burns with remembered deeds from across Valenmoor, warding off the Veil.

riddle_gate_seal.title: The Gatehouse Maxim
riddle_gate_seal.prompt: Carved above Oakhaven's arch: 'I have cities without stone, rivers without water, and forests without leaves. What guides every Wayfarer?'
riddle_gate_seal.successNote: The archway rune flares warm gold, unlocking the Guild Wayfarer's Seal!
riddle_gate_seal.failNote: The rune dims—no matter, you memorize the inscription and press onward.

riddle_silver_bark.title: Dryad Bark-Cipher
riddle_silver_bark.prompt: Three rings are carved into the silver birch: Dawn brings bloom, Dusk brings frost, and what light unveils hidden paths in the Canopy?
riddle_silver_bark.successNote: A recessed hollow opens in the birch, revealing a gleaming Moonstone Prism Lens!
riddle_silver_bark.failNote: Sap seals the hollow shut before you can pry it open.

riddle_hollow_chime.title: Shrine of the Three Winds
riddle_hollow_chime.prompt: To calm the screaming briars, strike the bell that answers silence without breaking it. Which metal rings true to the fey?
riddle_hollow_chime.successNote: Pure silver resonates through the mist! You claim the Heartwood Chime.
riddle_hollow_chime.failNote: A harsh discord echoes through the hollow, rattling the thorns.

riddle_astrolabe_ring.title: The Reversed Meridian
riddle_astrolabe_ring.prompt: The brass dial marks four tides: Zenith rises, Nadir sleeps, Ebb retreats. Which ring halts the backward spin of Lake Vesper?
riddle_astrolabe_ring.successNote: With a resonant click, the Brass Meridian Key drops cleanly into your palm!
riddle_astrolabe_ring.failNote: The brass rings spin faster for a breath, locking the compartment.

riddle_mirror_water.title: Inscription of Mirror Lake
riddle_mirror_water.prompt: 'Look down and you see the heavens; drop a stone and the sky shatters.' What preserves a reflection without breaking it?
riddle_mirror_water.successNote: The water calms to glass, lifting the Mirror-Shard of Vesper onto the plinth!
riddle_mirror_water.failNote: Ripples swallow the glyph before it stabilizes.

riddle_forge_valve.title: Dwarven-Elven Quench Seal
riddle_forge_valve.prompt: The foundry plaques warn: 'Fire shapes iron, Air feeds fire, but what disciplines the ley-vein when pride burns too bright?'
riddle_forge_valve.successNote: The cooling locker hisses open—you retrieve the Frost-Quench Brand!
riddle_forge_valve.failNote: Steam vents across the plaque, sealing the iron clasp.

riddle_smith_oath.title: Anvil of the True Smiths
riddle_smith_oath.prompt: Four tools hang over the master anvil. Which one binds two metals into one Concord rather than cutting them apart?
riddle_smith_oath.successNote: A secret drawer beneath the anvil yields the True Smiths' Charter!
riddle_smith_oath.failNote: The rune-lock cools into solid basalt.

riddle_prism_spire.title: Refraction of the First Spire
riddle_prism_spire.prompt: 'One beam enters the Crown of Glass; seven hues depart.' What binds scattered light back into a single anchor?
riddle_prism_spire.successNote: Alabaster light coalesces into the First Concord Prism!
riddle_prism_spire.failNote: The light fractures into harmless sparks.

riddle_sentinel_flame.title: The Last Sentinel's Vigil
riddle_sentinel_flame.prompt: At the edge of unmaking, gold rusts and blades snap. What is the only fuel the Aether Veil cannot devour?
riddle_sentinel_flame.successNote: The Unfading Oath-Lantern ignites with steady amber brilliance!
riddle_sentinel_flame.failNote: The lantern cools to a faint ember.

hollow_warden.name: Vaelen the Hollow-Bough
hollow_warden.title: Chapter I Boss · Corrupted Dryad Sentinel
hollow_warden.weaknessNote: Heartwood Chime shatters Vaelen's thorn armor (-2 AC, -6 HP)!

astral_warden.name: Arch-Orrery Wraith
astral_warden.title: Chapter II Boss · Star-Drowned Keeper
astral_warden.weaknessNote: Brass Meridian Key jams the wraith's orbital rings (-2 AC, -7 HP)!

cinder_drake.name: Ignaroth, Chained Cinder-Drake
cinder_drake.title: Chapter III Boss · Ley-Forged Wyrm
cinder_drake.weaknessNote: Frost-Quench Brand cracks Ignaroth's molten scales (-2 AC, -9 HP)!

veil_sovereign.name: The Unwoven Regent
veil_sovereign.title: Grand Finale Boss · Herald of the Aether Veil
veil_sovereign.weaknessNote: First Concord Prism anchors the Regent in mortal light (-2 AC, -12 HP)!

elricBanter: "Ah, still breathing! That already puts you ahead of last Tuesday's guild intake. Mind the sunsteel—it's hot off an entirely legal salvage contract."
"Welcome back to Elric's Curio Forge! Every relic on my shelves has provenance papers—mostly written by me, in very convincing calligraphy."
"Going back toward the Star-Spires? Take a Starleaf Draught. Dying in a ruin is terrible for repeat business."
"Between us, I once traded a talking helm for three barrels of Oakhaven cider. Best bargain of my life—the helm never stopped critiquing my posture."
"You bring the heroism, I bring the warded iron. Together we make the Aether Veil look like a mild drizzle."
